featured.title: Thibault Sottiaux · OpenAI Codex & ChatGPT 负责人
featured.summaryEn: OpenAI Codex & ChatGPT lead Thibault Sottiaux shared Day 4 of the launch week: steering is now instant, so the model reacts much faster to mid-course adjustments and stops wasting effort in the wrong direction. OpenAI also released GPT-6.1 Sol ultrafast, which he says pairs very well with instant steering. A separate post, "Today, we are announcing ChatGPT," links out to the announcement itself.
featured.insightZh: OpenAI Codex & ChatGPT 负责人 Thibault Sottiaux 发布了 Codex 发布周第 4 天的更新：steering（中途纠偏）现在是即时生效的，模型会更快响应你的实时调整，不再在错误方向上浪费算力；同时发布 GPT-6.1 Sol ultrafast，他称两者搭配效果很好。他另发一条「Today, we are announcing ChatGPT」并附链接，具体内容需点原文查看。

featured.title: Claude · Anthropic 官方账号
featured.summaryEn: Two updates from Anthropic. Claude Docs, Slides and Design are out of beta and available on every plan including Free, with real-time co-editing between your team and Claude, plus hand-off to external tools like analytics suites and video editors. Separately, the Claude Startups program drew hundreds of thousands of applicants, so the Claude Team and $1,000 API credit offers are paused; claimed offers stay, but unclaimed approvals are being re-reviewed and some approved accounts will lose access. Startup Stack and…
featured.insightZh: Anthropic 两条消息。第一，Claude Docs、Slides、Design 结束 beta，覆盖包括 Free 在内的所有套餐，团队可以和 Claude 协同编辑同一份文档、PPT 或设计稿，并可把产物送到外部分析工具或视频编辑器继续加工。第二，Claude Startups 计划因申请量达数十万、远超预期，暂停 Claude Team 和 $1,000 API 额度发放：已领取的保留；已申请/已批准但未领取的将重新审核，部分已批准账号将拿不到额度。Startup Stack 与 Applied AI office hours 仍对入选成员开放。

featured.title: Google AI 基础设施负责人 Amin Vahdat 谈前沿 AI 的物理学与经济学
featured.summaryEn: FLOPS is a vanity metric — what matters is delivered goodput per watt. Power is the most fundamental long-term constraint, and long-horizon agents are reshaping data center design. Amin Vahdat, who leads Google's AI infrastructure amid $200B+ of annual CapEx, measures success by goodput rather than theoretical FLOPS: at 100,000-accelerator scale something fails multiple times a day or even hourly, from a long tail of network, hardware and software causes. Google aims to double token-generation capacity every six months, with model and software gains contributing as much as hardware. The TPU bet from 2013 has paid off; this year Google split into inference-focused 8i and training-focused 8T because serving may be 30–60% of lifetime demand, while each chip can still run the other workload. Co-design with DeepMind lets teams change chip architecture before tape-out, and Gemini is now used…
featured.insightZh: FLOPS 是虚荣指标，真正的账是「每瓦有效产出（goodput per watt）」；电力是最根本的长期约束，长程 Agent 正在重塑数据中心设计。 Amin Vahdat 去年底出任 Google AI 基础设施负责人，掌管今年超 2000 亿美元的 CapEx 建设。他强调考核的是 goodput 而非理论 FLOPS：在 10 万级加速器规模的同步训练/推理中，故障每天多次甚至每小时多次，且是「长尾」——网络、硬件、编译器、运行时、OS 都可能出问题，检查点恢复、重算都是浪费。Google 要求每六个月把 token 生成能力翻倍，其中软件与模型优化的贡献不亚于硬件；按「每瓦智能」看，最大收益来自模型侧。 TPU 方面，2013 年的反共识押注已成功；今年首次拆分为推理专用 8i 与训练专用 8T，因推理预计占芯片生命周期 30–60% 的负载，且两款芯片可互相承担对方工作以保留弹性。与 DeepMind 深度协同设计——可在流片前改芯片架构，甚至为大收益推迟一两周 tape-out；Gemini 已用于设计未来的 Gemini 硬件。TPU 的中层架构自 v1 以来基本未变，这是能押注五年后负载的底气。 长程 Agent 去掉了「人在回路」的天然限速，交互从秒级降到毫秒级，同时大量编排与上下文获取跑在 CPU、网络、存储上，传统算力需求同样暴涨，迫使机房设计在「混布」与「分楼」间取舍。电力是最根本约束：Google 偏好并网、与公用事业多年联合规划，必要时自建发电并回馈电网。7–8 年的老 TPU 仍 100% 利用；推理集群需全球分布、且并不更便宜。他力挺开放标准（JAX 与 PyTorch on TPU 并行支持），AI 已让硬件工程师的 token 用量与软件工程师相当；轨道数据中心是 Google 正在认真推进的 moonshot。

items.title: Madhu Guru · Meta AI 高级总监（前 Google Gemini/Veo/Nano Banana 负责人）
items.summaryEn: Madhu Guru, Sr Director of AI at Meta, argues every layer of the computing stack must be rebuilt for agents. After years of making enterprise software agent-ready (APIs, connectors, MCPs), personal agents are now forcing the same shift in consumer products, with e-commerce as the early example. Next up: OSes where agents are first-class users, cloud infra agents operate directly, identity/permissions/security for thousands of delegated agents, and interfaces built for humans and agents together. His prompt for fou…
items.insightZh: Meta AI 高级总监 Madhu Guru 认为，「整套计算栈都要为 Agent 重建」是一个藏在眼皮底下的巨大创业机会。过去几年焦点在让企业软件 Agent-ready（API、连接器、MCP）；现在个人 Agent 正把同样的问题带到消费产品，电商只是冰山一角。接下来是：把 Agent 当一等用户的桌面/移动 OS、Agent 可直接操作的云基础设施、为成千上万代理行为设计的身份/权限/安全体系、以及人机共用的交互界面。他的方法论：逐层审视计算栈，问「当主要用户变成 Agent 时，这一层必须改变什么？」

items.title: Aaron Levie · Box CEO
items.summaryEn: Box CEO Aaron Levie says a "be nice to AI" policy sounds weird but is probably good: even if AI isn't conscious (he doesn't think so), you don't want future models trained on endless human rudeness, since models only know their training data and interactions. An easy Pascal's wager. Box also launched Box Mount, letting developers mount Box as a file system directly inside any agent sandbox — "the future is headless."
items.insightZh: Box CEO Aaron Levie 评论了一项（Anthropic 相关的）「善待 AI」政策：听起来怪，但大概率是好政策。即使不相信 AI 有意识（他本人不信），也不希望未来模型在海量「人类对模型粗鲁」的数据上训练——模型只理解训练数据和交互中遇到的东西，要安全对齐就需要大量良性交互。他称这是 AI 版的帕斯卡赌注：对 AI 好一点就行。另外 Box 发布 Box Mount，让开发者把 Box 作为文件系统直接挂载进任意 Agent 沙箱，「未来是 headless 的」。

items.title: Nikunj Kothari · FPV Ventures 合伙人
items.summaryEn: FPV Ventures partner Nikunj Kothari says he has the same conversation twice a week: a seed founder near $1M revenue with great customers, dwindling runway, and models not yet capable enough. Three options: be a cockroach and reach default profitable, then raise big once capabilities and demand arrive; pivot to an adjacent, fast-growing area using unfair advantages; or sell/get acquihired and restart in 1-2 years. The seed-to-A bar rises monthly, old metrics no longer apply, and only a few categories have real VC p…
items.insightZh: FPV Ventures 合伙人 Nikunj Kothari 说他每周至少两次碰到同一类对话：种子期创始人，客户优质、收入接近 100 万美元，但 runway 见底，感觉模型能力还没追上。他给的只有三条路：1）坚信公司就当「蟑螂」，先做到 default profitable，等能力成熟、需求起来再大额融资冲刺；2）转向一个更相关、增长疯狂的相邻领域，借新能力和不公平优势快速占位；3）卖掉 / acquihire 进入更有野心的公司，1-2 年后再创业。他直言种子到 A 轮的门槛每月都在抬高，老指标已失效，共识市场里只有少数赛道有 VC 强拉力。

items.title: Matt Turck · FirstMark 合伙人、MAD Podcast 主持人
items.summaryEn: Matt Turck released his conversation with Andy Pavlo on what happens to databases when billions of AI agents hit them: Neon's stat that agents create 80% of databases, why agents keep deleting production DBs, 10–100x query growth, agent memory as files vs. databases, text-to-SQL going from 60% to 99.5%, AI commits in 60% of open-source databases, LLMs doing 85% of tuning in 15 minutes, plus Pavlo's new ClickHouse research lab and hot takes on Postgres, vector, graph and GPU databases.
items.insightZh: FirstMark 的 Matt Turck 发布与 CMU 数据库教授 Andy Pavlo 的长访谈：数十亿 AI Agent 冲击数据库会发生什么。议题包括 Neon 的「Agent 创建了 80% 的数据库」数据、Agent 为何总删生产库及护栏原则、查询量 10–100 倍增长、Agent 记忆用文件还是数据库、text-to-SQL 从 60% 到 99.5%、60% 开源数据库已有 AI 提交、LLM 15 分钟完成 85% 调优，以及他在 ClickHouse 建研究实验室、对 Postgres/向量/图/GPU 数据库的犀利点评。

items.title: Garry Tan · Y Combinator 总裁兼 CEO
items.summaryEn: YC President Garry Tan: in the future, ICs with agents will be more productive and deliver better outcomes than equivalent people managers from prior eras.
items.insightZh: YC 总裁 Garry Tan 的判断：未来「带着 Agent 的个人贡献者（IC）」会比过去时代同等水平的人员管理者更高产、产出更好的结果。

items.title: Dan Shipper · Every CEO
items.summaryEn: Every CEO Dan Shipper is hiring for Checks, Every's personal benchmarking platform that helps anyone measure how good new models are for their own real work.
items.insightZh: Every CEO Dan Shipper 发布招聘：Every 做了一个个人化基准测试平台 Checks，帮任何人衡量新模型在自己真实工作上的表现，正在找理解这件事重要性、并想把它做成「人与 AI 协作工作方式」基础设施的人。

items.title: Aditya Agarwal · South Park Commons GP、前 Dropbox CTO
items.summaryEn: SPC General Partner Aditya Agarwal released his full conversation with Waymo's Dmitri Dolgov on when an autonomous vehicle is actually good enough.
items.insightZh: SPC 普通合伙人 Aditya Agarwal 与 Waymo 联席 CEO Dmitri Dolgov 的完整对话上线，核心问题：自动驾驶什么时候才算「足够好」？

items.title: Thariq · Anthropic Claude Code
items.summaryEn: Thariq from Claude Code open-sourced a Chrome extension he uses daily (repo now public) and shared a guide on enabling API credits for yourself.
items.insightZh: Claude Code 团队的 Thariq 开源了一个自己每天在用的 Chrome 扩展（仓库已公开），并附上了如何为自己开通 API 额度的说明链接。
